property_summary: For any proposal type that is not DAO, UTILS, or REWARD, when a vote causes the proposal to reach quorum for the first time, the proposal must transition to finalising state; the bug fails to do so, leaving mapPID_finalising[proposalID] false.
change_summary: Delete the call to _finalise(proposalID) inside the if block for non-DAO/UTILS/REWARD proposal types.
